about: Tactical battle damage tuning: one row (the client reads row 0 outside PvP). The real values died with the server; these are chosen so damage is neither zero nor capped (limit rates bracket 1.0, the random spread brackets 100% (in 1/10000: 9500-10500), a large cap) and the reversal mode is off. Assist-bonus fields are 0. Move ranges and the bystanders' escape distance are in centimetres (the client multiplies by 0.01): approach animations by distance 0.3/1.5/4/8 m, bystanders step 1.2 m aside. The miss (0.25) and critical (1.5) rates follow the community wiki; the rest are ours.

sources.note: which fields the tactical battle reads, and the values that would zero damage or crash
every number here is our choice (no source has the original tuning)
an evaded attack deals 1/4 damage (_missDamageRate 0.25); critical hits x1.5 (_criticalDamageRate 1.5)
Reversal on (Build 20): field meanings and units read in the client's ReversalManager; the gauge values are ours
assist bonus (Build 22): an assist adds (10% + up to 10/10/15/20% for rarity 3/4/5/6 at 10 boosts) of its own HP/ATK/DEF, formula read in the client (docs/research/19-assists.md); the limits are ours

sources.note: tactical battle basics (captures 2019-07/08): Reversal lasts 4 turns with speed +200% (_reversalAddSpeedUpRate 30000) and cool turns counting down twice as fast (_reversalAddSkillCoolTimeRate 5000); chain multipliers x1.1/x1.35/x1.5/x2.0 from the 1st to 4th consecutive action (_chain1..5Rate in percent added: the client takes 1 + rate/100, ChainManager.GetChainRate 0xFAABF0)
since 2019-02-26 an assist of the seat's own type passes on twice its share (_sameTypeAssistBonusRate 2000); Reversal: 4 turns, cool-downs halved (snA=703, 2018-08-30)
